action: Chase customers: check that November 16 transfers and Zelle payments went through once, and watch for phishing using the incident. Defenders: see the linked JPMorgan vendor event.
exec: A major US bank's payment outage may be linked to a cyberattack on its vendors, contradicting Chase's first explanation.
impact: Thousands of customers reported trouble accessing online accounts on November 16 (6abc); no exact count is given by the sources read.
plain: Chase customers had trouble with online banking and payments for several hours on November 16. Chase first said it was a software issue, but later said third-party providers were attacked; the cause is unclear.
summary: Chase customers had trouble with online banking, transactions and Zelle payments for hours on November 16. On the day, Chase said a software issue caused it, with no evidence it was cyber-related; the FBI told NewsNation it saw no malicious activity. On November 19 KTEN reported a Chase social media post saying third-party providers were targeted, retracting that statement; the cause is now disputed.
title: JPMorgan Chase outage delays payments; cause disputed

validation.note: Compared 6abc live blog and Yahoo News (FBI via NewsNation): both give Chase software bug, not cyber-related; FBI no malicious activity.
